import os import json import time import re from datetime import datetime from urllib.parse import urljoin from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright from bs4 import BeautifulSoup # ========================================== # 配置区域 # ========================================== MAX_ITEMS = 5 # 任务目标：爬取前5条 OUTPUT_DIR = r"d:\llm_mcp_genpy\pygen\output" BASE_URL = "https://www.centralbank.org.bz" START_URL = "https://www.centralbank.org.bz/publications-search" # ========================================== # 工具函数 # ========================================== def clean_html_content(html_content, base_url): """ 将 HTML 中的相对路径转换为绝对路径 修复图片 src 和链接 href """ if not html_content: return "" try: soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, 'html.parser') # 修复图片链接 for img in soup.find_all('img'): if img.get('src'): img['src'] = urljoin(base_url, img['src']) # 修复超链接 for a in soup.find_all('a'): if a.get('href'): a['href'] = urljoin(base_url, a['href']) return str(soup) except Exception as e: print(f"[WARN] Content cleaning failed: {e}") return html_content def parse_date(date_str): """ 解析日期字符串，支持多种格式 """ if not date_str: return "" try: date_str = date_str.strip() # 尝试多种常见格式 formats = [ "%d %B %Y", # 26 February 2026 "%B %d, %Y", # February 26, 2026 "%Y-%m-%d", # 2026-02-26 "%d/%m/%Y", # 26/02/2026 "%m/%d/%Y" # 02/26/2026 ] for fmt in formats: try: dt = datetime.strptime(date_str, fmt) return dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") except: continue return date_str except Exception: return date_str def save_results(articles, output_path): """保存爬取结果为JSON""" result = { "total": len(articles), "crawlTime": datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "articles": articles } with open(output_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(result, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) print(f"[INFO] Saved {len(articles)} articles to {output_path}") # ========================================== # 爬虫主逻辑 # ========================================== def run_crawler(): # 确保输出目录存在 os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True) print("[INFO] Starting crawler...") with sync_playwright() as p: # 启动浏览器，配置反爬参数 browser = p.chromium.launch( headless=True, args=["--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled", "--no-sandbox"] ) context = browser.new_context( viewport={'width': 1920, 'height': 1080}, user_agent="Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36" ) # 创建主页面 page = context.new_page() articles = [] try: print(f"[INFO] Navigating to {START_URL}") page.goto(START_URL, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=60000) # 【修复策略1】尝试点击搜索按钮 # 某些页面是搜索表单，必须点击搜索才能看到结果 try: search_btn = page.query_selector("input[type='submit'][value='Search'], button:has-text('Search')") if search_btn: print("[INFO] Found search button, clicking to load results...") search_btn.click() page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle", timeout=10000) except Exception as e: print(f"[WARN] Search button interaction failed: {e}") # 循环翻页抓取 while len(articles) < MAX_ITEMS: # 【修复策略2】使用多重选择器探测列表项 # 针对不同页面结构提供备选方案 item_selectors = [ "ul.item-list li", # 原有选择器 ".search-results .item", # 常见搜索结果 ".sf_search_result", # Sitefinity CMS "div.result-item", # 通用 "table tr:has(a)", # 表格布局 "div.row:has(a)", # Bootstrap 布局 "li:has(a)" # 宽泛列表 ] items = [] chosen_selector = "" # 寻找有效的选择器 for sel in item_selectors: try: # 检查是否存在该选择器的元素 if page.query_selector(sel): # 进一步验证：必须包含链接 candidates = page.query_selector_all(sel) valid_candidates = [c for c in candidates if c.query_selector("a")] if len(valid_candidates) > 0: items = valid_candidates chosen_selector = sel print(f"[INFO] Found {len(items)} items using selector: {sel}") break except: continue # 【修复策略3】兜底方案：如果没有找到特定结构的列表，尝试抓取主内容区的所有链接 if not items: print("[WARN] No items found with specific selectors. Trying generic fallback...") try: main_content = page.query_selector("main, #content, #main, body") if main_content: links = main_content.query_selector_all("a") # 过滤掉短文本链接，假设新闻标题长度 > 15 # 获取链接的父元素作为 item potential_items = [] seen_links = set() for l in links: txt = l.inner_text().strip() href = l.get_attribute("href") if len(txt) > 15 and href and href not in seen_links: seen_links.add(href) # 获取父元素 parent = l.evaluate_handle("el => el.parentElement") potential_items.append(parent.as_element()) items = potential_items[:10] # 限制数量 print(f"[INFO] Fallback: Found {len(items)} potential items from links.") except Exception as e: print(f"[ERROR] Fallback failed: {e}") if not items: print("[INFO] No items found, stopping.") break # 遍历当前页条目 for item in items: if len(articles) >= MAX_ITEMS: break try: # 1. 提取标题和链接 link_el = item.query_selector("a") # 如果 item 本身就是 a 标签 if not link_el and item.evaluate("el => el.tagName === 'A'"): link_el = item if not link_el: continue title = link_el.inner_text().strip() if not title: continue link = link_el.get_attribute("href") if link: link = urljoin(BASE_URL, link) # 2. 提取日期 (尝试多种方式) date_val = "" try: # 优先找日期类名的元素 date_el = item.query_selector(".date, .time, span[class*='date'], div[class*='date']") if date_el: date_val = parse_date(date_el.inner_text().strip()) # 如果没找到，扫描 item 文本中的日期格式 if not date_val: text = item.inner_text() # 匹配 YYYY-MM-DD 或 DD Month YYYY date_match = re.search(r'\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}|\d{1,2}\s+[A-Za-z]+\s+\d{4}', text) if date_match: date_val = parse_date(date_match.group(0)) except: pass # 3. 提取摘要 summary = "" try: summary_el = item.query_selector(".description, .summary, p") if summary_el: summary = summary_el.inner_text().strip() except: pass article_data = { "id": str(len(articles) + 1), "title": title, "date": date_val, "author": "Central Bank of Belize", "source": "Central Bank of Belize", "sourceUrl": link, "summary": summary, "content": "" } # 4. 处理详情页 if link: # 检查是否为文件链接 lower_link = link.lower() is_file = any(lower_link.endswith(ext) for ext in ['.pdf', '.doc', '.docx', '.xls', '.xlsx']) if is_file: print(f"[INFO] File detected, skipping detail page: {title[:30]}...") article_data["content"] = f'Download Document' else: print(f"[INFO] Processing detail page: {title[:30]}...") detail_page = context.new_page() try: detail_page.goto(link, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=30000) # 尝试提取正文 content_html = "" # 扩展内容选择器列表 selectors = [ "div.group.margin-large", "#top", "div[role='main']", "article", ".content", "#content" ] for sel in selectors: if detail_page.query_selector(sel): content_html = detail_page.inner_html(sel) if len(content_html) > 100: break if not content_html: content_html = summary # 清洗内容 article_data["content"] = clean_html_content(content_html, link) # 详情页日期补全 if not date_val: d_el = detail_page.query_selector(".date, .time, span[class*='date']") if d_el: article_data["date"] = parse_date(d_el.inner_text().strip()) except Exception as e: print(f"[WARN] Failed to load detail page: {e}") article_data["content"] = f"

Failed to load content. Original Link

" finally: detail_page.close() time.sleep(0.5) articles.append(article_data) except Exception as e: print(f"[ERROR] Error processing item: {e}") continue # 5. 翻页逻辑 if len(articles) < MAX_ITEMS: next_btn = page.query_selector("a:has-text('Next'), a:has-text('»'), .pagination .next a") if next_btn: next_url = next_btn.get_attribute("href") if next_url: next_url = urljoin(BASE_URL, next_url) print(f"[INFO] Navigating to next page: {next_url}") page.goto(next_url, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=30000) else: break else: break else: break except Exception as e: print(f"[ERROR] Main crawler loop failed: {e}") finally: browser.close() # 保存结果 timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S") filename = f"centralbank_belize_news_{timestamp}.json" output_path = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, filename) save_results(articles, output_path) if __name__ == "__main__": run_crawler()
